stem: Which detail best supports the idea that Jackson and Crocker were inventive?

options.label: F
options.text: They used wheels wrapped with rope when tires were punctured.

options.label: G
options.text: They bought a used Winton instead of buying a new one.

options.label: H
options.text: They moved boulders out of the way in the Sierra Nevadas.

options.label: J
options.text: They used goggles to protect Bud’s eyes from road dust.
